title: [Prime] 3M Claw Drywall Picture Hanger, 5 Pack $14.50 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] 3M Claw Drywall Picture Hanger, 5 Pack $14.50 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[Franc-T] Why? what did the clock every do to you?
[whitelie] We have gtek on our brick walls and these have been great for hanging pictures, clocks, etc. Heaps easier than drilling and plugging a brick wall. Good deal as they're somewhat expensive from Bunnings
[jv] Claw Drywall Picture Hanger, $14.50
It's the CRAW , not the Craw !!!
[itstuan] Thanks, ordered one to see how it holds. At this capacity, I'm thinking of hanging a mirror.
[joedante] Would these work mounting a 4-10 port switch/router on those standard screw mount points?
[Blitzfx] Similar from bunnings would be this
https://www.bunnings.com.au/3m-claw-drywall-picture-hangers-…
[AdrianW] These aren't going to work in the majority of WA houses.You'd end up with chunks of plaster on the floor.
[itstuan] Majority of WA houses are occupied by women.
[bboarder] is the plaster on double brick homes not suitable for these?
[AdrianW] @bboarder: Usually pushing anything into the wall will just make the plaster split and fall out, especially if you're putting weight on it.
I drill into the wall, add a plastic wall plug and then use screws.
[reactor-au] Can get these on aliexpress for over a year already
[browser] Haha, not exactly rocket science to replicate.
Reminded of this Kickstarter project , they didn't think of the popularity and did not have a patent. The original still retails for US$60+, knockoff $5-10 on AliExpress.
[dufflover] Anyone used ones from Ali to get a feel if it's reliable weight rating? Like it won't be made of a soft or brittle Chinesium?
Genuine question cos doing a quick search it's def a cheap way to grab some just in case…
[reactor-au] I have the 3M and ali, I rate size for size they're about the same, I think ali only had the smaller ones when I checked last year
[browser] For light weight photo frames (under 3kg) just use something like this (rated 7kg for drywall), more cost effective and less intrusive.
But for heavier objects, such as mirror, would trust 3M.
[prankster] NO REGRETS – No big holes left in your walls
i mean it does leave 2 small holes so not sure if i'm allowed to have this at this place i'm renting. I'll have to get that other 3M like this right https://www.target.com.au/p/1-pack-3m-command-general-purpos…
[alxr0101] Do they come in metric weights? Not sure the pound ones are compatible with Australian drywall….
